customManagers.description: Vaultwarden image in infra/vault. Renovate's built-in terraform manager only handles Docker/K8s provider resources, not google_cloud_run_v2_service, so this regex extracts the digest and lets the docker datasource track upstream vaultwarden/server (mirror.gcr.io serves byte-identical digests to docker.io).

packageRules.description: Group first-party GitHub Actions (actions/*); auto-merge minor and patch — low supply-chain risk
Group third-party GitHub Actions; require manual review — these run with deploy secrets
Do not automatically upgrade the Python runtime requirement

Pin Python (uv/pyproject.toml) dependencies to exact versions on every update, instead of a range. Required for minimumReleaseAge to actually work with uv: Renovate can only stop `uv lock` from grabbing a too-new version if the version in pyproject.toml is an exact pin, not a range (see renovatebot/renovate#41624). Must stay its own rule — rangeStrategy can't be combined with matchUpdateTypes in one packageRule, because rangeStrategy is evaluated before Renovate knows the update type.
Group Python (uv/pyproject.toml) minor and patch updates into one PR, separate from the actions group — different lockfile, keeps uv.lock churn reviewable on its own
Do not auto-update the Python base image; adopt interpreter upgrades manually

Vaultwarden image (infra/vault): keep it out of every group and never auto-merge — it is the password manager. Commit as fix(infra) so a bump flows through release-please (path-scoped to the vault component) -> vault@ tag -> deploy-vault.yml.
